verdict.rationale: RudderStack's Audiences feature is defined as building audiences on warehouse sources declared via YAML entities (Profiles) and syncing them downstream — a data-engineer-oriented, SQL/YAML-driven workflow, not a marketer-facing visual no-code builder with size estimation. No evidence describes a drag-and-drop/visual audience builder or estimated audience size before activation. missing for 10: visual/no-code audience builder UI, audience size estimation preview, marketer self-service workflow without engineering involvement.
